tools.name: pocketlaw_list_documents
tools.description: List documents with their name, status, template, sign status and metadata. Read only. GET /api/v1/documents.

tools.name: pocketlaw_search_documents
tools.description: List documents whose external metadata matches a filter, for example an id from your own system. Read only. POST /api/v1/documents/search.

tools.name: pocketlaw_get_document
tools.description: Get one document by id, with its field values, attachments and sign request. Read only. GET /api/v1/documents/{id}.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_templates
tools.description: List contract templates with their categories and locales. Use a template id with pocketlaw_create_document. Read only. GET /api/v1/templates.

tools.name: pocketlaw_get_template
tools.description: Get one template by id, with its fields, field rules and conditional logic. Read only. GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_folders
tools.description: List document folders with their parent ids. Read only. GET /api/v1/folders.

tools.name: pocketlaw_search_folders
tools.description: List folders matching a parent id or a name. Read only. POST /api/v1/folders/search.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Pocketlaw account (id, name, e-mail). Read only. GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: pocketlaw_list_sign_providers
tools.description: List the e-signature providers the account can use for sign requests. Read only. GET /api/v1/sign-requests/provider.

tools.name: pocketlaw_create_document
tools.description: Create a new document from a template, with its field values. Creates a record only: nothing is sent for signature. Get the template id and its field ids first (pocketlaw_get_template). POST /api/v1/documents.

tools.name: pocketlaw_update_document
tools.description: Change a document's name, field values or external metadata. Only the fields you pass change. Does not send the document for signature. PATCH /api/v1/documents/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_search_folders, pocketlaw_create_document · Private data: pocketlaw_list_documents, pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_get_document, pocketlaw_list_folders, pocketlaw_create_document, pocketlaw_update_document · Public sink: pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_search_folders, pocketlaw_create_document, pocketlaw_update_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_search_folders, pocketlaw_create_document · Private data: pocketlaw_list_documents, pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_get_document, pocketlaw_list_folders, pocketlaw_create_document, pocketlaw_update_document · Public sink: pocketlaw_search_documents, pocketlaw_search_folders, pocketlaw_create_document, pocketlaw_update_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
